# Every Debt Clock
https://everydebtclock.com/

Live US, state, country and wealth-fund clocks built from official figures. The US national debt was $40,608,506,856,903.25 ($40.61 trillion) at Treasury's Nov 12, 2026 close.

## Key pages
- / : US national debt clock. Official total $40,608,506,856,903.25 as of Nov 12, 2026 (Treasury, Debt to the Penny). The live projection is re-based every business day.
- /how-much-is-the-national-debt/ : Plain answer and a breakdown of the official total, public vs intragovernmental debt, and the statutory limit.
- /national-debt-per-person/ : Official total divided by the Census Vintage 2025 population ($118,813.07 per person).
- /your-share/ : Your share of that official total. Birth year, and optional state, household size, and income, are calculated in the browser and are not stored.
- /national-debt-by-year/ : Treasury fiscal-year-end totals and OMB debt-to-GDP ratios, FY1940 to the latest year.
- /41-trillion/ : Live countdown to the next trillion, using the homepage clock's Debt to the Penny base and per-second rate, plus each trillion crossing in that daily series.
- /when-will-debt-hit-41-trillion/ : Redirects to /41-trillion/. GitHub Pages serves this as an HTML refresh with a canonical link, not an HTTP 301.
- /national-debt-by-president/ : Debt at the start and end of each term. Debt to the Penny on or before the date from 1993; Historical Debt Outstanding annual records before that.
- /interest-on-the-national-debt/ : Cash interest paid this fiscal year, MTS net interest by fiscal year, and Treasury's interest-expense dataset by fiscal year.
- /world/ : World Debt Clock. General government gross debt for every IMF economy. A national or Eurostat or QPSD stock is used only when it is general government gross debt; otherwise the row is the IMF World Economic Outlook estimate. Narrower official series are labeled and not added.
- /world-government-debt/ : Redirects to /world/. GitHub Pages serves this as an HTML refresh with a canonical link, not an HTTP 301.
- /global-debt-clock/ : Redirects to /world/ the same way.
- /countries/ : National debt clocks by country. Economies with an official source keep that source; the rest are IMF World Economic Outlook estimates.
- /states/ : State and local debt clocks for every US state and Washington, DC, from official Census figures.
- /wealth/ : Sovereign wealth funds ranked by assets and assets per citizen.
- /methodology/ : Sources, how the live ticker is calculated, and how it is checked against Treasury.
- /about/ : Who runs the site (Hypergame LLC), the main data sources, and the update schedule.
- /privacy/ : Privacy policy, including analytics, data downloads, and cookies if ads are shown.
- /contact/ : Email hello@everydebtclock.com.
- /advertise/ : Sponsorship on the US clock and the national-debt-by-year page.
- /data/ : Free CSV files and charts of the US and world series this site publishes. Free to use with credit: Source: EveryDebtClock.com.
- /embed/ : Free debt clock widget. Paste-in clocks for the US, every state and Washington, DC, every country, and the world. Each one links back to its full page.

## Debt by year

- /countries/brazil/debt-by-year/ : Brazil gross government debt by year, 2006–2026. Banco Central do Brasil, SGS series 13761, Dívida bruta do governo geral (DBGG), R$ million.
- /countries/canada/debt-by-year/ : Canada federal debt by year, 2003–2026. Bank of Canada Valet, series V42141673, Government of Canada total securities outstanding (inflation adjusted), C$ millions.
- /countries/china/debt-by-year/ : China central government debt by year, 2025–2026. Ministry of Finance of China, Central Government Operations And Debt (SDDS), quarterly central government debt balance, RMB billion.
- /countries/france/debt-by-year/ : France central government debt by year, 2000–2026. Eurostat, Quarterly government debt (gov_10q_ggdebt), central government (S1311), Maastricht debt, million euro.
- /countries/germany/debt-by-year/ : Germany central government debt by year, 2000–2026. Eurostat, Quarterly government debt (gov_10q_ggdebt), central government (S1311), Maastricht debt, million euro.
- /countries/india/debt-by-year/ : India central government liabilities by year, 2025–2026. Department of Economic Affairs, Ministry of Finance, Quarterly Report on Public Debt Management, Table 4.1 Total Liabilities of Central Government, item H Gross Liabilities as per FRBM Act, rupees crore.
- /countries/italy/debt-by-year/ : Italy central government debt by year, 2000–2026. Eurostat, Quarterly government debt (gov_10q_ggdebt), central government (S1311), Maastricht debt, million euro.
- /countries/japan/debt-by-year/ : Japan national government debt by year, 2022–2026. Ministry of Finance Japan, Central Government Debt (government bonds, borrowings, financing bills), quarterly table, 100 million yen.
- /countries/united-kingdom/debt-by-year/ : United Kingdom government debt by year, 1975–2026. Office for National Statistics, Public sector finances, series BKPX, general government consolidated gross debt (Maastricht), £ million.
- /states/california/debt-by-year/ : California state and local debt by year, 1992–2024. US Census Bureau, Annual Survey of State and Local Government Finances, table GS00LOCALFIN, total debt outstanding (LF0231), survey years 2017–2024.
- /states/florida/debt-by-year/ : Florida state and local debt by year, 1992–2024. US Census Bureau, Annual Survey of State and Local Government Finances, table GS00LOCALFIN, total debt outstanding (LF0231), survey years 2017–2024.
- /states/illinois/debt-by-year/ : Illinois state and local debt by year, 1992–2024. US Census Bureau, Annual Survey of State and Local Government Finances, table GS00LOCALFIN, total debt outstanding (LF0231), survey years 2017–2024.
- /states/massachusetts/debt-by-year/ : Massachusetts state and local debt by year, 1992–2024. US Census Bureau, Annual Survey of State and Local Government Finances, table GS00LOCALFIN, total debt outstanding (LF0231), survey years 2017–2024.
- /states/new-jersey/debt-by-year/ : New Jersey state and local debt by year, 1992–2024. US Census Bureau, Annual Survey of State and Local Government Finances, table GS00LOCALFIN, total debt outstanding (LF0231), survey years 2017–2024.
- /states/new-york/debt-by-year/ : New York state and local debt by year, 1992–2024. US Census Bureau, Annual Survey of State and Local Government Finances, table GS00LOCALFIN, total debt outstanding (LF0231), survey years 2017–2024.
- /states/ohio/debt-by-year/ : Ohio state and local debt by year, 1992–2024. US Census Bureau, Annual Survey of State and Local Government Finances, table GS00LOCALFIN, total debt outstanding (LF0231), survey years 2017–2024.
- /states/pennsylvania/debt-by-year/ : Pennsylvania state and local debt by year, 1992–2024. US Census Bureau, Annual Survey of State and Local Government Finances, table GS00LOCALFIN, total debt outstanding (LF0231), survey years 2017–2024.
- /states/texas/debt-by-year/ : Texas state and local debt by year, 1992–2024. US Census Bureau, Annual Survey of State and Local Government Finances, table GS00LOCALFIN, total debt outstanding (LF0231), survey years 2017–2024.
- /states/washington/debt-by-year/ : Washington state and local debt by year, 1992–2024. US Census Bureau, Annual Survey of State and Local Government Finances, table GS00LOCALFIN, total debt outstanding (LF0231), survey years 2017–2024.
- Skipped australia: The Australian Office of Financial Management data hub (aofm.gov.au) did not respond, so the monthly workbook behind the Australia clock could not be read as a full history. The clock file only keeps the latest year of that workbook, which is not the long official series.
## Data
US figures come from Treasury Fiscal Data (Debt to the Penny; Daily Treasury Statement Table III-C for debt subject to the limit) and Census Bureau population estimates. State, country and wealth pages name their own official sources. Every projected figure is labelled as a projection.

## Machine-readable
- https://everydebtclock.com/data/ — CSV downloads (debt by year, by president, per person, interest, states, countries) and chart images
- https://everydebtclock.com/api/daily.json — latest official US total and daily changes
- https://everydebtclock.com/data/data.json — all US tickers, official bases and rates
- https://everydebtclock.com/api/places.json — state and country clocks
- https://everydebtclock.com/api/world.json — best-source world total, with source tier and as-of date for each economy
- https://everydebtclock.com/api/world_government_debt.json — IMF general-government estimate
- https://everydebtclock.com/api/wealth.json — wealth-fund ranking
- https://everydebtclock.com/sitemap.xml
- https://everydebtclock.com/llms.txt
